representative_posts.text: Pro athletes are programmed from the time they're like 12 to "die on the field". representative_posts.author: witcheshut.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: somebullshitpost.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The real threat isn't fascism, it's that these guys are doing it while being visibly pathetic. Can't even stage a coup with dignity. That's somehow worse

representative_posts.text: The thing a lot of people, and especially a lot of people in tech, struggle with understanding is that you don’t get to personally benefit from the arrangements of fascism and not have that morally blow back onto you as something you personally were responsible for contributing to

representative_posts.author: itgetzbybuckner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's only fascism if they self-enrich, at the expense of the country.

representative_posts.author: cliff229.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Without organized resistance, Fascism is the inevitable final stage of capitalism. It protects the extremes of a capitalist culture. When there is nothing left, charlatans like Musk promise a fantasy alternative. In the 1930's and 40's it was the land of the jews. Today it's life on mars.

representative_posts.author: mrxexon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Humanity pulls the lever about every 4th generation. When the old warnings have died off with the old people. Fascism is like an 80 year locust. Behind it is rich people trying to stay above you. And you beneath them. But it's a new century... And it's far from over.

representative_posts.author: biblioraptorphd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This sums it all up (from End Times Fascism)

representative_posts.author: jackfeerick.bsky.social

Rather, allegiance to the Leader or the Reich or the Volk is a vehicle for *individual* self-aggrandizement. When I wear the uniform, I'm the Big Man, and you have to do what I say.

representative_posts.author: thankgod4ever.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: lol true though, that is apparently their job to be fascism lite

representative_posts.author: necroticempire.bsky.social

Right 🙄

representative_posts.author: ditsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Never mistake fascism for strength. It’s the refuge of cowards.

representative_posts.author: lalegault.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you want to survive fascism you have to be able to unlearn a lifetime of brainwashing that tells you broken windows justify breaking people. Look to Ireland 🇮🇪, France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, & Albania 🇦🇱 where people are rising up. Support them & learn from them. American/Canadian exceptionalism imprisons us.
